inlineImageAndParagraph.text: ICSI Verification confirms if a Company Secretary (CS) is a registered, active member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), a statutory body. Decentro's API instantly validates CS credentials by querying their unique ICSI membership number against the official ICSI registry. It returns name, membership type, and active status in real time, enabling compliant professional onboarding.

items.description: Securely collect the Company Secretary's unique ICSI membership or registration number, such as ACS12345 or FCS67890, as the primary input for initiating the verification process.
Decentro's API securely queries the official ICSI member database directly, performing a real-time validation of the provided membership number against the authoritative registry.
Upon successful validation, the API extracts and returns comprehensive member details including their full name, membership grade, active status, and regional chapter affiliation.
